about: The application keys Manage holds a plan for (CompanyAppRegistry::planKeys(), served to Engage at GET v1/inbound/engage/app-keys). This file is byte-identical in manage-aicountly (server-php/tests/fixtures/manage_plan_app_keys.json) and engage-aicountly (server-php/tests/_support/fixtures/manage_plan_app_keys.json); each repository's test pins its own list to it. Change both in the same change.
